factValues.name: gr:fact-45c11f1cd6e9b2a8_fv
factValues.value: For the year ending 31/12/2025 the company was entitled to exemption under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-4bec784cbd3061b0_fv
factValues.value: The members have not required the company to obtain an audit in accordance with section 476 of the Companies Act 2006.

factValues.name: gr:fact-261bde03f8a1574f_fv
factValues.value: The directors acknowledge their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Act with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-47ef34e7c5e0cffb_fv
factValues.value: These accounts have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.

factValues.name: gr:fact-b818255bbfa3ef2f_fv
factValues.value: The directors have decided not to deliver to the registrar a copy of the company's profit and loss account.

factValues.name: gr:fact-50365863078a60b7_fv
factValues.value: Depreciation has been provided at the following rates in order to write off the assets over their estimated useful lives.

factValues.name: gr:fact-cd8fe858d800979c_fv
factValues.value: Goodwill arising in connection with the acquisition of businesses is capitalised and amortised over its estimated economic life of 10 years. Goodwill is reviewed annually for impairment if events or changes in circumstances indicate that the carrying value may not be recoverable.

factValues.name: gr:fact-9a7162f4a1c71f80_fv
factValues.value:
During the period Witnall Automatics Limited borrowed £350,297 from its parent company Real Fun Group Limited in order to facilitate the purchase of an additional trading property and bingo hall.
The balance owed to Real Fun Group Limited at 31 December 2025 was £2,202,162 (2024 - £1,851,865).
